resources.string: Tap a mainline segment to simulate a failure in that section.
Line Solver uses material data sourced in part from SlackData, the open gear database maintained by the International Slackline Association (ISA).
This contribution is gratefully acknowledged. The use of ISA data does not imply ISA certification or endorsement of the simulation results.
Selected webbing material specifications used by Line Solver are sourced from SlackData, the open gear database maintained by the International Slackline Association (ISA).
The SlackData gear catalogue is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution–ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0).
Line Solver additionally uses material information from other sources and independently constructed constitutive models.
The CC BY-SA 4.0 license applies to the covered SlackData catalogue data and relevant adaptations, not automatically to the entire Line Solver application.

Catalogue adaptations include SI-unit conversion, record reconciliation and model classification. Original source metadata and modification tracking are retained. Covered catalogue adaptations are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
